name: Dumbbell Front Raise
summary: An isolation exercise for the front delts, raising dumbbells in front of the body to shoulder height.
setup: Stand tall holding a light dumbbell in each hand in front of the thighs.
Keep a slight bend in the elbows.
Brace the core and keep the ribs down.
execution: Raise the dumbbells forward to about shoulder height.
Keep arms close to straight with the same elbow angle.
mistakes: Swinging the body: lower the weight and brace the core.
Raising too high with an arched back: stop at shoulder height.
